2014_spells.darkvision.description: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.
2014_spells.darkvision.effectSummary: Change a target: that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet
2014_spells.darkvision.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. The effect lasts for 8 hours.
